output_str = ""
flag = False

def check_dot(index):
    return input_str[index:index+3] == "dot"

def check_at(index):
    return input_str[index:index+2] == "at"

i = 0
while i < len(input_str):
    if i > 0 and i + 2 < len(input_str) and check_dot(i):
        output_str += '.'
        i += 3
        continue
    if not flag and i > 0 and i + 1 < len(input_str) and check_at(i):
        output_str += '@'
        i += 2
        flag = True
        continue
    output_str += input_str[i]
    i += 1

print(output_str)
